01 · The list

Question words,
level by level

The question words of Chinese: what, who, where, when, why, how, which, how many and how much, from the HSK vocabulary lists with readings and meanings. Learn these first and you can ask for everything else.

In Lock&Learn Chinese these words sit in their level packs (HSK 1, HSK 3, HSK 5, HSK 6), one per glance on the widget: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 1 is free; every other pack opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

03 · Questions

Asked and
answered

What are the question words in Chinese?

The table lists the 11 interrogatives on the HSK vocabulary lists with their readings and meanings, each beginner-level one with a real sentence that shows where it sits in the question.

Which HSK levels are these words from?

7 from HSK 1, 1 from HSK 3, 1 from HSK 5, 2 from HSK 6. The level chip on each row says where the word sits, so you can stop at your level or read ahead. Beginner-level words carry a real example sentence; the rest show word, pinyin and meaning, with their sentences in the app.

How do I learn question words words on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. Enable the level packs these words come from (HSK 1, HSK 3, HSK 5 and more). A word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
